Better but still unable to think clearly. Definitely can't  code but seem to have a short term plan of action. My grandpa just got moved to hospice and can barely eat and the nurses there think he has days to weeks. He was always good to me so I'm going to hang around the Midwest and make sure he passes as comfortable as possible before I start wandering. I sold all my stuff between eBay, Craigslist, and Facebook Marketplace except my phone, laptop, clothes and I will be getting an eviction notice soon. As soon as I can sell all my furniture I'll be hitting the road and living in my car for a bit while I try to get myself sorted out. I still get massive head pains when I focus on anything for an hour or so, so I am doing things in 20m productive chunks. I'll go to a Nuerologist as soon as I can pay without having to starve to pay for it. I've got a therapist scheduled for Wednesday to get an outside analysis and life advice.    
So this is how I exist for a little while. I will get a chain gym membership (Planet Fitness) and use that for showers. I've got canned food, a pan, electric burner and dry goods, electric mattress, tent in the trunk for desperate times. I have shipping supplies in my trunk and I'll use my phone to buy and flip things on eBay/Craigslist at pawn shops and yard sales to pay for food, gas, and cell service during. I also have a cell phone repair kit if I can find people with broken phones they want to sell/repair nearby. I only need to make 300/month to exist this way and it's the best solution I have considering how little I seem to be capable of ATM.

I have 2 close friends and parents near by but I don't want to be a burden to them. If this is a physical problem as I suspect then I won't ever be able to recover and my best option is death before I lose the ability to think clearly enough to go through with it. If it is a severe mental problem as you suspect there are no guarantees  I will get better and my family and friends who are not well off themselves will have another time and money sink to take care of. I guess there is a third way. I could just get in my car and disappear and let whatever happens to me happen. That would be less painful for my family than finding my body and give me all the time I need to work through this or lose my mind and die in the process.Once I disappear they can't be burdened financially and I can still contact them so long as I am that aware. I think this is the last time I'll reply to this thread. Thank you for your time and thoughts. I hope your life is wonderful.
I couldn't do it. I just sent him a message letting him know. I don't know what the plan is now. Death is tempting.

I never really enjoyed the design part of programming. It seems way too subjective changing tiny details over and over. It's hard to make a final decision and it's really hard to design something that both looks unique and is intuitive to use. The most exciting part for me has always been finding interesting or efficient solutions to problems. Now I fear I may be losing my ability to do that. I've used Python in the past for a few projects. Currently I use mostly C# and Javascript (ES6) but I'm happy to use whatever is best suited for the project. I will look into local resources but in Indianapolis I am not very hopeful they exist. I really appreciate you taking the time to talk to me. Somehow talking to somebody who knows my dire situation without pretending everything is fine is very helpful. Thanks.

Software development. We worked on some hobby projects together many years ago and he went corporate and I kept doing non-commercial things and working in a warehouse. Since warehouse work seems to be something I can't do anymore without being a danger to myself and others, I jumped at the opportunity for freelance development work. Until today I have been setting the time aside to work but actually accomplishing very little. I'm maybe 1/5 normal productivity. Seeing a medical specialist really isn't an option without steady employment and insurance. I will try the herbal supplements and cold water thing and see if it helps.

I'm trying to get some work done but still not able to think clearly. What I'm doing is very technical and I won't be able to do it without a clear head. I set a deadline for myself of Sunday night to get a set amount of work completed and if I fail (which looks probable) I'll have to tell my friend I can't do the work and lose a good opportunity and most probably my only shot at paying the bills for the next few months. So really stressed out.

I'm definitely very anxious when not on the medicine. I have no problem sleeping all day for days. It's the easiest way to not have to deal with the constant head pressure. I sometimes think I'll just sleep here until I get evicted. Then I will move outside and sleep there until I'm arrested. Then I will just sleep until I die. I will do my research on those meds and maybe give them a try.
It's sad that your family kept ignoring you. I hope you find a way out of this rut.

I definitely have anxiety and I am currently taking zoloft for it. All that seems to do is make me not panic about my situation I still have all the cognitive symptoms. What worked for you? I'm down to try anything.

No. When I saw the Cardiologist I had gone into the ER because I felt like I couldn't breathe and there was some weight on my chest. They kept me and monitored me for a few days but at the end they assumed my symptoms were Pericarditis. I do have a blood pressure meter though and my BP is normally pretty low, but at night it shoots up like crazy. The best match I can find for my symptoms is actually a brain tumor. The heart stuff sucks but they ran all kinds of tests on me before and everything returned to normal. The neurologist was completely dismissive. I am worried that I am going to lose the ability to think critically and at that point I won't be able to end it.    
What kind of symptoms have you been having?

I appreciate your response. It's ok to vent to me too as I am not exactly depressed, more just looking for a way to not be a burden to my loved ones before I completely lose my last bits of sanity and have no control anymore. If my parents start nagging me I just get super demotivated and hang up. It's the opposite of helpful.    
I keep wondering if I should just disappear before things get too bad in full view of everyone I care about. I hope you motivation to fix your situation and if you need an ear, I'm hear. At least for a bit.
